words.example: Who should the auditors treat as their POC (Point of Contact)?
words.exampleZh: 审计人员应该把谁当作对接人？

words.example: Please bring an SME (Subject Matter Expert) from registration to the demo.
words.exampleZh: 请从挂号处带一位业务专家来参加演示。

words.meaning: 项目管理办公室（Project Management Office）
words.example: Ask the PMO (Project Management Office) to gather this week's status.
words.exampleZh: 请项目管理办公室收集本周的进展状态。

words.meaning: 服务级别协议（Service Level Agreement）
words.example: The SLA (Service Level Agreement) promises new badges within two days.
words.exampleZh: 服务级别协议承诺新工牌在两天内做好。

words.meaning: 运营级别协议（Operational Level Agreement）
words.example: Our OLA (Operational Level Agreement) says how quickly payroll must answer.
words.exampleZh: 我们的运营级别协议规定了薪酬处必须多快回复。

words.example: Seccomp blocked an unexpected syscall from the lab container this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上，系统调用过滤拦住了检验容器里一次不该出现的系统调用。

words.example: AppArmor denied the lab container when it tried to read the host shadow file.
words.exampleZh: 检验容器试图读宿主机的 shadow 文件时，应用防护拒绝了它。

words.example: SELinux blocked the viewer from writing outside its own data directory.
words.exampleZh: 强制访问控制拦住了阅片程序，不让它写到自己的数据目录外面。

words.example: Drop unused capabilities on the lab container so it cannot change network routes.
words.exampleZh: 去掉检验容器用不到的权限能力，它就不能改网络路由。

words.example: That sysctl raised the connection backlog so the portal survives the morning rush.
words.exampleZh: 那个内核参数把连接队列调大了，门户才撑得住早高峰。
